title: Source-only all-local-Q3 multiplication-word majorant
question: Does the source-only slice of all actual Q3 local potential words admit a volume-independent entire generating majorant with both orientations?

model.local_choices: one onsite plus three Q3 edges plus six spatial bonds at an active site
model.coefficient_norm: sum of absolute source coefficients times source_radius^degree
model.word_bound: A(R)^n for a length-n connected source-only multiplication word; factorial EGF exp(t*A(R))

scoped_verdict: On the source-only slice, the exact onsite, Q3-edge and spatial-bond coefficient tables give a local summed rate A(R)=4741/2240 at R=1/2. Summing connected word choices at each length and the factorial time weights is bounded by exp(t*A(R)); reversing endpoints or source orientation preserves the coefficient norm.
open_after_test: field-dependent coefficients and unbounded operator domains
actual commutator/Duhamel incidence beyond multiplication words
two-sided energy or state-weighted topology and spatial first-passage decay
all-shape exhaustion Cauchy and common alpha
KMS, ground/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A

adversarial_review.check: Setting field variables to zero removes q-dependent coefficients; the result is not an operator-domain estimate.
The ten local choices are a bounded-degree combinatorial envelope, not a proof that every operator history has exactly those choices after support growth.
Endpoint reversal and simultaneous source sign reversal preserve the absolute coefficient norm, but do not prove adjoint dynamics.
The factorial exponential bound is a source-only multiplication-word series, not a Q3 real-time resummation.
R221 checks exact rational coefficient and rate fixtures only.
No thermodynamic dynamics, OS/KMS, GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A result follows.

scope.closed: Source-only all-local-Q3 multiplication-word coefficient majorant and orientation-symmetric factorial generating envelope.
scope.not_closed: Field-dependent operator history, commutator incidence, spatial decay, all-shape exhaustion, common alpha, KMS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

next_action: Lift the source-only majorant to a field/energy-weighted common-core norm or record the exact failure of that lift; only then attempt the two-orientation first-passage and common-alpha estimates.
no_overclaim: This package proves only a source-only coefficient-level envelope. It does not prove the actual Q3 real-time history, thermodynamic QFT dynamics, C6, Sector A, Pre-A, TECT production or a Clay result.
